exclusions: Full source closure retains95 baseline and97 candidate modules,17 gate descriptors and27/26 unresolved diagnostics. Missing provider source, dynamic gates and unknown domains remain incomplete even when selected source paths read no gates.

Selected worker environment fixture replaces actual environment detection; it does not exercise main-thread storage, account identity, native providers, cache propagation across workers or a real session. Actual Globals, MeUser memoizers, factory, Wid, parser and MsgKey remain original code.

Missing JSErrorLoggingConfig, cr34987, cr38444 and baseline cr5411 are fail-closed dependency fixtures; cr6640=null selects the real Promise fallback. Source pins retain original providers and full graph rather than hiding these execution exclusions.

Invalid Wid constructor paths require missing canonical Babel wrapNativeSuper/inheritsLoose bootstrap. These paths are not asserted as passing vendor errors. Supported extends/taggedTemplateLiteralLoose are explicit compatibility fixtures, not proof of original bootstrap.

Parser field observations do not establish validity of parsed Wids or complete message identity. Delimiter splitting intentionally truncates underscore-containing IDs when supplied as strings; object IDs retain their literal values.

No actual Wid/MsgKey object arguments or retained instance argument handles are injected. Positive equals, from/to Wid constructor forms, same-instance identity and clone identity remain unexercised; clone checks data snapshots only.
newId/newId_DEPRECATED, random providers, SHA256 generation, Signal, Noise, authentication and crypto acceptance remain unexecuted.

Finite PN/LID source-selected cache transitions do not enumerate all identity changes, inputs or asynchronous schedules. Generated ID/Unicode/participant examples characterize inputs rather than claim exhaustive domains.
No containers, isolated production TS scheduling, accounts, network, named-library adapters, upstream implementation compliance or customer availability are established.
